data.narrative:
Revere operates in the Defense & Security sector, a space populated by 23 peer companies across funding stages. The comparable universe includes 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with top-tier peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The target's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, limiting stage-specific benchmarking.

Peer-median valuation methodology could not be applied. A search for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier matches within Defense & Security returned fewer than three datapoints in each category, falling short of the three-company minimum required for reliable median estimation. While 23 same-sector peers exist in aggregate, the narrow filters necessary to control for stage and scale comparability yielded insufficient overlap. An all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given Defense & Security's distinct capital structures and exit multiples.

Without sufficient stage-matched private comparables and absent disclosed financials for Revere, triangulation via peer multiples cannot be completed. The analysis supports deferring valuation until either (1) Revere discloses funding stage, revenue, or burn metrics; (2) additional same-stage Defense & Security peers enter the dataset; or (3) public comp multiples (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) are anchored to target-specific growth or margin assumptions. Key uncertainties include contract backlog, customer concentration, and burn rate—standard inputs for early-stage defense valuations.
